node.label: Glomerular capillary wire loop deposits
node.definition: Glomerulus showing markedly and irregularly thickened capillary walls with massive fuchsinophilic subendothelial deposits, resulting in narrowing of capillary lumina. This feature is said to resemble a wire loop.

evidence.snippet: Systemic lupus erythematosus 18: Glomerular capillary wire loop deposits (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
